items.title: GSPO: Towards Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Language Models
items.summary: PAPER DISCORD Introduction Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for scaling language models and enhancing their deep reasoning and problem-solving capabilities. To scale RL, the foremost prerequisite is maintaining stable and robust training dynamics. items.summaryZh: 本文介绍了通义千问团队为大语言模型可扩展强化学习提出的全新算法——群序列策略优化（GSPO）。强化学习是大模型提升深度推理和问题解决能力的核心范式，但现有算法（如GRPO）在长程训练中常遭遇严重的不稳定性并导致不可逆的模型崩溃。GSPO算法的提出旨在维持稳定稳健的训练动态，从而扫清借助增加计算资源进一步提升模型性能的障碍。
